name: codegen-agent-terminals
description: Opens one VS Code terminal per OpenCode codegen agent (CODEGEN_DISPLAY=vscode).

codegenAgentTerminals.spoolDirectory.description: Directory watched for agent jobs. Empty means ~/.local/state/codegen/vscode-jobs (CODEGEN_VSCODE_SPOOL in the runners).

codegenAgentTerminals.node.description: Node binary used to run agent-view.mjs inside the terminal.
